CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 602830571d619ee621a5ad91d5b39f056d3b14f4. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 602830571d619ee621a5ad91d5b39f056d3b14f4 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r5, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-merge-subject-harden-r5 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r5; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
This is a BODY-ONLY REPAIR of open pull request #2697 (R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-HARDEN, fix/r10-merge-subject-harden). The fixer's code is handed off at handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden 602830571d619ee621a5ad91d5b39f056d3b14f4 with body at handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden (BODY.md). The orchestrator's update_pr to that handoff was REFUSED by tools/pr/prepr.sh with one line: REFUSE figures -- "A figure whose command cannot run states the same number whatever the world holds. Repair the command, or state the figure without one and say what it rests on." Nothing was pushed to the PR.

Cut a worktree from origin/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden, merge origin/main, run tools/pr/prepr.sh against the body (read the fixer contract dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and writing-for-agents.md for the figures rule) and find every figure it names. For each: either repair its command so it runs on the merged tree and prints the figure, or state the figure without a command and say what it rests on. Re-take any figure whose command you repair. No code change unless a figure needs a rerun that shows the code is wrong; if so, stop and say so in your handoff.

Push refs only: handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden (only if the merge of main moved it) plus handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden (topic is r10-merge-subject-harden even though this dispatch ref carries a -r5 suffix). Answer `## Red checks` for every red check.

No host or home paths in anything you push (cite repo-relative paths only). Do not end the turn while a background job runs.
